hero.title: Ink on paper, *done properly.*
hero.lede: Offset, digital and letterpress printing, graphic design, signs and mailing, from a downtown shop that has been serving Aiken for more than 150 years.

sections.title: From concept to *completion*
sections.intro: Our in-house staff can help you put your ideas to paper, whatever your company needs printed.

items.title: Offset & digital printing
items.text: Books, flyers, forms and business cards. Customize every detail from size to fold, with a wide variety of papers and finishes.

items.title: Graphic design
items.text: Need a new logo, flyer or book design? Our designers create an image that helps you stand out.

items.title: Signs & banners
items.text: Yard signs, banners, retractable banners and faux checks, made from the best materials available.

items.title: Mailing
items.text: Standard, bulk and EDDM mail. We handle the printing and the mailing to reach your audience.

items.title: Motorsports printing
items.text: Custom hero cards, handouts and promotional pieces for professional and sportsman racers.

items.title: Letterpress
items.text: Traditional letterpress, foil stamping, die cutting, embossing, numbering, perforating and scoring.

sections.title: Old-school service, *since 1867*

image.alt: The Howell Printing building on Barnwell Avenue

body: Howell Printing Co. was founded in 1867, and from the first day in business our name has stood for quality throughout Aiken and the surrounding areas.
Old-school service and top-quality work is what we are all about. We source exactly what you need, work with our suppliers to get the best possible pricing, and pass the savings along to you.

quote.text: Come by and talk to one of our graphic designers about your next project.

sections.title: If it can be printed, *ask us*
Have a project in mind?
sections.text: Call, email, or stop in at the shop on Barnwell Avenue.
